def hidden_rule_fn(state):
    n = len(state[0])
    next_state = [[0] * n for _ in range(1)]
    for i in range(n):
        # Compute hexad: offsets -3, -2, -1, +1, +2, +3 (toroidal)
        offsets = [-3, -2, -1, 1, 2, 3]
        hexad = [state[0][(i + off) % n] for off in offsets]
        s = sum(hexad) % 3
        value = state[0][i]
        next_state[0][i] = (s + value) % 3
    return next_state
